items: 【Multi-functional Pocket Design】 This teacher tote bag is a must-have necessity for educators and professionals! Featuring 4 pen slots, 2 smaller pockets for compact item, a breathable mesh pocket, and a slightly larger pocket for a slightly big item, it keeps everything organized.The multi-sized pocket design makes it equally convenient as a nurse's bag or a diaper bag.

【Professional Accordion File Organizer】 Stay organized with this tote bag for work featuring a handy accordion file organizer with 4 compartments for A4 documents, books, or lesson plans. Its sturdy design keeps papers tidy, while the lightweight build makes it perfect for on-the-go. A must-have for work bags for women who need efficiency!

【Large Cup Holder】 Designed with a stretchable side pocket that accommodates 14-60 oz water bottles, this work tote bags for women ensures spill-proof convenience. The reinforced stitching and durable fabric make it ideal for teachers nurses, or moms using it as a diaper bag.

【Computer Compartment + Large Capacity】 This laptop bag for women includes a padded 15.6-inch computer compartment and a high-capacity main section for books/files. Multiple interior pockets organize pens/phones, while reinforced handles add durability. Suitable as a teacher tote bag or work tote bag for women, it meets all work needs.

【Versatile Work Bag】 This LOVEVOOK tote bag offers a luggage sleeve for a suitcase and an adjustable shoulder strap,which suits travel or daily use. Durable water-repellent fabric can effectively prevent accidental splashes of water from wetting items. It's a thoughtful gift for teachers, nurse,mom,or other busy professionals.
